title: Selecting and Flying RNAV Approaches | MSFS Pilot Training
description:
Mastering RNAV in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is the ultimate survival skill for the modern pilot. In this MSFS 2024 A-Z episode, we move beyond the "old days" of chasing radio signals to the high-tech world of Area Navigation. You’ll learn how to navigate complex arrivals, understand RNP 0.3 accuracy, and use the G1000 NXi to fly a rock-solid LPV approach.

We break down the RNAV vs RNP theory, then demo the specific steps to load your procedure, activate the approach, and manage the Glide Path (GP) manually when it matters most. Whether you fly a Cessna or an A320, this is the logic you need to fly through any weather with professional-grade precision.

🕒 Chapters
00:00 - Intro
00:39 - What is RNAV?
01:09 - RNAV vs RNP
02:00 - RNAV/RNP chart explained
06:09 - Demo: selecting the RNAV approach
07:21 - Demo: final approach
15:21 - Which approach mode do you prefer?
